caption:
River current? That's a system.

Downstream speed = boat + current. Upstream speed = boat − current. Add or subtract and you're done.

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: River current problems are secretly a system. Find the current's speed.

youtube.title: SAT Word Problem: Upstream, Downstream System
youtube.description: Turn with-the-current and against-the-current speeds into a system. SAT-style practice question (original).
